_status: SUPERSEDED — NOT ACCURACY EVIDENCE. Produced from London_Bakers_Dataset.xlsx, an extrapolated 731-day series (304,614 rows, 2023-10-01..2025-09-30 shifted +377 days). The real workbook is Real London Bakers 5 Week Performance.xlsx (13,544 rows, 2026-09-01..2026-10-05). The decision that stands is docs/validation/frozen_config.json.
_what: Frozen Phase 2 decision and protocol. Committed BEFORE the sealed hold-out is read, so the hold-out is a single confirmatory run and not another round of selection. Nothing here may be edited after 2026-09-29..2026-10-05 is scored.

productionEngine.reason: The Holt-Winters engine scored 36.91% pooled dev WAPE against velocity's 29.62%, and lost in 7 of 7 folds. Paired per-SKU-day difference +1.007 units, 95% bootstrap CI [0.851, 1.167] — reliably worse. It is not switched on.

winner.label: store weekday profile x SKU level
winner.note: Lowest pooled dev WAPE and reliably better than both M1 and velocity, but it exists only in scripts/validation/forecastBacktest.js. Recorded as a candidate for a later phase; nothing in src/ was changed for it.

config.level: mean of the SKU's own 28 training days
config.weekdayIndex: mean store-wide units per weekday over the same 28 days, divided by the mean across all days
config.forecast: level x weekdayIndex for the projected day's weekday, clipped at 0

rejectedEngine.label: Holt-Winters, in-service grid search (src/services/holtWinters.js)
rejectedEngine.diagnosis: Grid search picked alpha = 0.1 (its lowest value) in 238 of 350 fits and beta = 0 every time: a selector sitting on its own boundary means one-step in-sample SSE is fitting noise. Error grows with horizon (+2.4 points h1-3 to h4-7) and bias is one-sided (-1.01%).

protocol.selectionRule: Lowest pooled dev WAPE wins, but only if its paired per-SKU-day absolute error versus M1 has a 95% bootstrap interval entirely below 0; otherwise 'no reliable improvement' and FORECAST_ENGINE stays velocity. Engine changes additionally require the winner to be a shipped engine that reliably beats the incumbent. No tuning after the numbers are seen.
protocol.m7Ridge: not run — precondition (M4/M5 do not beat M1) not met
